paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the average performance of several models, represented by their parameter count, on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks. The x-axis, labeled “Model Size (log scale),” displays a linear scale ranging from 70m to 7.0B, with tick intervals of 160m and 1.0B, indicating values of approximately 70 million, 160 million, 1.0 billion, 1.4 billion, and 2.8 billion parameters. The y-axis, labeled “Avg. Performance (%)”, is a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately 70% to 80%, with tick intervals of 10%. A red line, indicated by the marker shape ‘.’, represents the performance of the Precision model, which begins at approximately 68% at 70m and steadily increases to 78% at 7.0B. A blue line, indicated by the marker shape ‘.’, represents the performance of the Recall model, which starts at approximately 64% at 70m and rises to 74% at 7.0B. A purple line, indicated by the marker shape ‘.’, represents the performance of the F1-score model, beginning at 60% at 70m and increasing to 70% at 7.0B. Finally, a dark blue line, indicated by the marker shape ‘.’, represents the performance of the model, starting at approximately 62% at 70m and reaching approximately 72% at 7.0B.
